title: Reference-data store: provenance records with literal re-find; on-demand SSRF-guarded fetch; disk budget enforced
author: muse-b3
covers: Hand recipe (kind repro-steps) for SXE-41, authored by muse-b3 as author of record (CB-0828) from the fixer's supplied content: /Users/dutch/.zuko/quality/CHECK-SXE-41.md (seat B2, branch sx/solver-core, PRG-E2; depends on SXE-00). Scope: reference-data store — provenance records, literal re-find, on-demand SSRF-guarded fetch, disk budget. NOTE for the reviewer and the fixer: the supplied check file's done-criteria/behaviour sections are the SXE-00 engine-framework template text; the store-specific legs (literal re-find of a stored value, SSRF refusal on a guarded fetch, disk-budget refusal) should be sharpened by B2 at build and this draft updated before activation. Reference discipline as SXE-00: cited free/public source, checker re-pulls and recomputes (DC-01). Reviewer: at activation, confirm the discriminator transcript below still fails against the pinned pre-fix instance and bind packet_id.
discriminator: Pre-fix transcript (replayed by the fixer 2026-11-17 against f4f1f77ff, from CHECK-SXE-41.md): grep over server/lib at the ref finds no occurrence of 'refdata' — the reference-data store does not exist at this build, so every step fails at step one.
steps: Confirm the store exists at the ref: a 'refdata' module is present under server/lib and loads (pre-fix: absent).
Write a provenance record for a cited value, then literal-re-find it: the stored value + unit must be re-found verbatim in the stored excerpt (no paraphrase accepted).

Fetch on demand through the SSRF-guarded path: a private/loopback target is refused by the guard; a public source returns and is stored as an excerpt (≤ the store's excerpt discipline), never a full page as citation.
Exceed the disk budget with synthetic records — the write is refused honestly at the budget, existing records stay readable.
